# Ship ensure and record update as readable Avowry source with the toolchain
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #348, sha256:851b8a5c599819d2bf3c48b2e1e02cfe16a8a2734e105f74e02f617c9b470037). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** story
- **Repository:** avowry (ExtensionKeywords.cs; ensure as D105 layer 1 / card 159; record update; C# adapter)
- **Source:** .mob/records/platform-options/standalone-recommendation-2026-11-08.md (Proposed stories (PM), card 348) and the product owner's decisions of 2026-11-08 (stand-alone platform report: core library as Avowry source in the framing; file card 344 to card 349 as Draft; Ari's execution constraint applied).
- **Depends on:** card 344
- **Story:** As Ari, I want the standard patterns (ensure, record update) shipped as readable Avowry source versioned with the toolchain, so that I read what a pattern means instead of inferring it.
- **Consumer value:** Ari reads what ensure and record update mean from spec-backed Avowry source; we see it when opening the library shows the failing and passing cases.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Scenario: [S][O][E] ensure in the library
     Given `ensure`, and Ari often cannot run code at all
     When Ari opens the library
     Then its spec shows the failing and passing case
  2. Scenario: [S] record update in the library
     Given record update
     When Ari opens the library
     Then its spec shows a copy of a record with one field changed
  3. Scenario: [I] shipped with the toolchain
     Given the toolchain install from card 344
     When Ari opens the library beside that binary
     Then the patterns are Avowry source versioned with the toolchain
  Letters that do not apply: [Z] this card ships the patterns that exist; [M] further patterns and the D95 store convention (provisional in the C# adapter) stay out; [B] how much of D105 layer 1 is compiler built-in versus expressible as source is an unknown, not a criterion.
- **Not in this card:** a registry or git-URL modules (no consumer has asked, so no story); card 345–card 347; card 349; publishing; a language server; a UI; other targets; store operations.
- **Unknowns:** how much of D105's layer 1 is compiler built-in versus expressible as source; the repo has no Avowry-source library, import or module mechanism today; architect called the design unknown. A spike is allowed only once card 348 is the top story.
- **Size:** M
